Capital FM reports: Ruto calls Gachagua ‘Chief Extortionist’ in fresh attack

clusters.headline: Nairobi Implements Water Rationing Amid Low Reservoir Capacity
aiSummaryBullets: Nairobi City Water and Sewerage Company scheduled a 24-hour supply shutdown beginning November 9.
Water levels at the Ndakaini reservoir have dropped by 35 percent, prompting regional rationing measures.

clusters.headline: President Ruto Launches Four-Day Development Tour In Gusii Region
aiSummaryBullets: President William Ruto initiated a four-day development tour across Nyamira and Kisii counties.
The official visit includes the commissioning of various government projects and engagement with local residents.

clusters.headline: Authorities Seize Large Quantity Of Methamphetamine In Kwale County
aiSummaryBullets: Law enforcement officials in Kenya confiscated 454 kilograms of suspected methamphetamine.
The seized narcotics are estimated to have a street value of approximately Sh3.6 billion.

clusters.headline: Thousands of Ethiopian Refugees Face Food Shortages In Moyale Area
aiSummaryBullets: More than 50,000 individuals from Ethiopia have sought refuge in Kenya following violent regional conflicts.
The displaced population is currently residing in overcrowded camp facilities located in the Moyale border region.

clusters.headline: Suspects Injure Police Officer With Water Bucket During Cell Escape
aiSummaryBullets: Three suspects escaped from police custody after attacking an officer.
The suspects reportedly used a water bucket to strike the official on the head.

clusters.headline: TikTok Removes Over 750,000 Videos In Kenya Over Policy Violations
aiSummaryBullets: TikTok deleted 750,185 videos in Kenya due to community guideline violations during the second quarter of 2026.
The platform reported that 99.8 percent of these removals occurred automatically before any user reports were filed.

clusters.headline: Football Kenya Federation Ousts Vice President In Meru Meeting
aiSummaryBullets: Football Kenya Federation (FKF) vice president MacDonald Mariga was removed from office.
The decision to expel Mariga and six other National Executive Committee members was unanimous.

clusters.headline: Kenyan Cult Leader Receives 200 Year Sentence For Shakahola Deaths
aiSummaryBullets: Paul Mackenzie was sentenced to 200 years in prison for his role in the deaths of 191 individuals.
The judicial decision follows a conviction on 191 counts of murder issued by the court on October 19, 2026.

clusters.headline: Chief Justice Martha Koome Receives Honorary Degree From KeMU
aiSummaryBullets: Kenya Methodist University granted an honorary Doctor of Letters to Chief Justice Martha Koome.
The award was presented to the Chief Justice during the institution's 26th graduation ceremony in Meru.
